quarterly_data.quarter: Foxsemicon Integrated Technology IR presentation: MOPS 341320260909E001 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The Chon Buri plant in Thailand entered mass production in July; increasing production scale is expected to contribute to revenue and earnings growth. With customers' medium- to long-term demand remaining strong, the company approved its Phase II expansion in Thailand with a planned investment of US$234 million to prepare for capacity needs beyond 2028. Manufacturing footprint: 8 sites in 4 regions (HVM sites in Taiwan, Thailand and China; NPI R&D center in Silicon Valley)
quarterly_data.figure: Thailand Phase II planned investment US$234 million; Chon Buri mass production from July

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxsemicon Integrated Technology IR presentation: MOPS 341320260909E001 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company view: AI and HPC continue to drive structural growth in WFE; advances in GAA, HBM and advanced packaging increase process and chip complexity, driving demand for deposition, etch and inspection equipment 'where FITI has a strong presence'; new product introduction (NPI) programs continue to increase. Own-brand non-process automation (reticle and wafer transfer / handling), micro-contamination prevention and wafer macro / micro inspection equipment serve front-end wafer fabs and wafer-level advanced packaging and test facilities
